Assistant A’s response is incorrect: it rejects arrays of different sizes, sorts the arrays in O(n log n) time while claiming O(n), and its median formula is wrong even for equal-length arrays. Assistant B provides a correct binary-search solution that handles different sizes, uses O(1) space, and runs in O(log(min(n, m))) time, which is within O(n). Although B’s opening claim that O(n) time is impossible is inaccurate, the actual implementation is correct and satisfies the requested constraints.

[[B]]
